state_context: R2_12_PROTOCOL_FROZEN (unchanged by this artifact -- this is additive preparation, not a state transition)
purpose: Describes what must be checked on the real Windows target host before R2_12_RUNTIME_READY may be declared, and the two preparation tools that implement those checks without performing any runtime benchmark.

readiness_driver.what_it_does: Runs ~20 host-identity/capability/machine-state checks against the live host, reading every scientific constant (model/runtime identity, frozen SHA-256 values) directly from hardware_contract.json rather than duplicating them. Each check reports PASS, BLOCKING_FAILURE, or ADVISORY. Writes experiments/R2-12-runtime-validation/RUNTIME-READINESS-REPORT.json and exits 0 only if there are zero BLOCKING_FAILUREs.
what_it_explicitly_does_not_do: does not invoke any of the 120 counted benchmark runs
does not execute any measured policy comparison
does not create or populate any runtime-result artifact
does not, by itself, mark R2_12_RUNTIME_READY
checks_implemented: runtime_resolved (reuses argine.research2.runtime_resolver, never a hand-rolled discovery)
cpu_identity_collected (advisory -- no frozen expected value exists yet)
power_mode (blocking only if detected as a power-saving plan; advisory if unqueryable)

sufficient_free_ram (reuses argine.planner.plan() feasibility, the same authoritative gate `argine research trace` itself uses; fixed 8 GiB fallback threshold reused from tools/r2_11_capture_driver.py, not newly invented)
expert_store_path_exists (model_path.with_suffix('.psxs'); blocking for R2-12 specifically, since without a built store the comparison degrades to plain mmap)
operator_attested_clean_environment (blocking unless the operator explicitly passes --operator-attests-clean-environment; never defaulted to True)

execution_driver_preparation.what_it_does: Implements exact 144-run matrix generation (24 discarded warmups + 120 counted executions), partitioned into three separable 40-counted-execution budget sessions (4 GiB primary / 1.5 GiB stress / 8 GiB null-control), preserving the frozen ABBA/alternating-opener sequence and warmup ordering from run_order.json exactly. Implements atomic per-run persistence, duplicate-run-ID mismatch detection, a campaign-duration exclusive lock, and full resumability.
what_it_explicitly_does_not_do: real execution is not implemented in this file: _execute_cell_NOT_IMPLEMENTED() always raises NotImplementedError, regardless of CLI flags -- there is no code path in this file capable of launching a real benchmark
the CLI refuses to run at all unless --mock is passed, and --mock only writes synthetic_test_record=True / real_execution=False placeholder records used to exercise persistence/resumability logic
execution_driver_preparation.matrix_verified: 4 workloads x 3 budgets x 2 policies x 5 repetitions = 120 counted, + 4x3x2x1 = 24 warmup, = 144 total; verified by unit test, not merely asserted
execution_driver_preparation.session_partition_verified: exactly 40 counted + 8 warmup = 48 runs per budget session (1.5/4/8 GiB), verified by unit test

what_this_artifact_does_not_authorize: This artifact does NOT mark R2_12_RUNTIME_READY.

R2_12_RUNTIME_READY may only be declared, in a separate later commit, after the readiness driver has actually been run on the real Windows target host and its RUNTIME-READINESS-REPORT.json reviewed and found overall=PASS.
This artifact does NOT create R2_12_RUNTIME_OPENED.
No runtime benchmark, measured policy comparison, or tokens/s measurement was performed to produce this artifact.
next_required_step_before_runtime_ready: Run `python tools\r2_12_readiness_driver.py --operator-attests-clean-environment` on the real Windows target host. If overall=PASS, review the report, then (in a separate turn/commit) author R2_12_RUNTIME_READY referencing that report.
